 Judgment
The writ petition is filed, inter-alia, to direct the 4 th respondent to consider and dispose of Exts.P5 and P8 appeals and Exts.P6 and P9 stay petitions, expeditiously.

2. Aggrieved by Ext.P3 demand notice cum suspension order and P7 cancellation order, the petitioner has preferred Exts.P5 and P8 appeals and P6 and P9 stay petitions, respectively, before the 4th respondent on 15.07.2025 and 24.07.2025.
The petitioner is apprehensive that, during the pendency of the above appeals and stay petitions, the 2 nd respondent may enforce Exts.P3 and P7 orders.

sentences.text: Heard; the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel for the respondents.

On a consideration of the facts and materials on record, especially that Exts.P5 and P8 appeals and P6 and P9 stay petitions are pending consideration before the 4 th WP(C) NO. 27979 OF 2025 2025:KER:59627 respondent, without expressing anything on the merits of the matter, I direct the 4th respondent to consider and dispose of Exts.P5 and P8 appeals and P6 and P9 stay petitions, in accordance with law, and as expeditiously as possible, at any rate within 60 days from the date of production of a copy of this judgment, after affording the petitioner an opportunity of being heard.
Until such time orders are passed on the above appeals and petitions, all further proceedings pursuant to Exts.P3 and P7 orders shall stand deferred.
